d:
Yuvraj, a commanding giant bull, tips the scale at an imposing 1,400kg. His owner reveals that he declined an astounding 7 crore offer for this majestic creature. To put this into perspective, Yuvraj's value surpasses that of numerous high-end supercars! But why is he worth so much? Yuvraj, the epitome of the Murrah buffalo breed, boasts an annual income of 50 lakh for his owner. The secret lies in his lineage; his semen is highly coveted among buffalo breeders.
Miliye ek aur shandar yuvraj se jo sabse mehenge sand hai vishv men!
